Where the edge comes from

Intelligence no other OSRS tool ships

Five server-side models hunting mispriced items around the clock — every chart is a live model output you can act on.

⚠️
Live

Dump scanner

A three-classifier dump scorer flags real crashes in seconds and ranks them by recovery odds — so you see which dips are flips and which are traps.

📐
Calibrated

Calibrated buy/sell bands

Conformal-calibrated buy/sell intervals targeting ~90% coverage — know the range a price should trade in before you commit gp. Thin items get flagged before they waste a GE slot.

🌊
Predicted

Ripple forecasting

When one item moves, related items follow. The ripple model surfaces the second-order flips a point price never reveals — before the market catches up.

📈
Rhythm

Momentum & seasonality

CUSUM regime detection plus per-item seasonal rhythm tells a temporary dip from a structural shift — so you're not averaging down into a losing position.

⏳
Weibull hazard

Next-Dump Forecast

A Weibull timing model flags items likely to dump in the next few hours — stage your gp before the crash and buy the bottom, not the slide.

Advisory only — GrandFlipOut is a third-party analytics companion. It tracks prices, flags opportunities and fires alerts — it never places or automates Grand Exchange trades. You always execute in-game. Not affiliated with Jagex.
